style: Original professional game production art, practical retro futurism circa 2070, exceptional carefully maintained industrial design, restrained tactile materials, sharp details suitable for deliberate pixel reduction, no copied franchise designs

frames.subject: original 2070 reclaimed Union compact linear accelerator, long coherent charcoal steel chassis and squared barrel, bone ceramic insulators, physical exposed copper winding recesses, small restrained red charge lamps, believable industrial gun rather than neon toy.
